messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected (P1) — token-count drift + delayed usage emits observed for eu-west-1. Alerting on emitter_delta > 3000 for 5m. Notify oncall.
Sam (oncall): saw this. any customer-facing alerts? :eyes:
Lina (billing): getting red flags from the shadow tally — counts are lagging for ~30-60m, and a small set of customers showing overage flags due to duplicated tokens on replays. Not all customers affected.
Omar (ml-infra): quick check — model-serving KV cache TTL looks normal. This smells like emitter backpressure + retry amplification.
Sam (oncall): can you share a quick query for the affected producer shard?
Omar (ml-infra): paste:```
SELECT shard, count(*) as emits, avg(latency_ms) FROM metering.emitter WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY shard;
```
Lina (billing): results: shard-7 shows emit surge then drop -> backlog rebuilt later, duplicate sequence ids for ~2k tokens.
Jess (support): we already saw 12 customers get automated overage emails in the last hour. pausing email alerts now. @Aiden can you pause billing notifications?
Aiden (sre): paused notification webhook at 12:05 UTC. Confirmed: no new emails will be sent. :white_check_mark:
Sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause notifications (done), 2) enable emitter-safe-mode (drop retries > 3), 3) start live backfill re-emit dedupe job, 4) communicate to customers. I'm running step 2 now.
Omar (ml-infra): enabling emitter-safe-mode flag:```
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/flags/emitter_safe_mode -d '{"enabled":true}'
```
Omar (ml-infra): flag set. we're throttling retries and adding idempotency checks at ingress.
Lina (billing): starting dedupe backfill: job id bf-2026-03-17-01. It will mark duplicate seq_ids and suppress re-emit to billing aggregator. ETA ~20m.
Sam (oncall): what's customer impact baseline? Are we overcounting or undercounting?
Lina (billing): mixed: initial burst created duplicate tokens -> some customers got transient overage flags; subsequent delayed emits led to undercount for a window. Net effect varies per account. We'll run per-customer reconciliation after backfill.
Jess (support): I'll draft an incident banner and a support playbook snippet: short note + how to check billing flags. Holding until we have reconciliation plan.
Aiden (sre): monitoring note: set temporary alert threshold to emitter_delta>1500 to catch residual spikes. Also added a dashboard widget for duplicate_seq_rate.
Omar (ml-infra): root cause hypothesis: upstream proxy had a retry storm when Kafka partition leader rotated; retries lacked idempotency tokens for a brief period. Kernel kicks and network blips amplified replays.
Sam (oncall): action items assigned: Lina -> run full reconciliation and prepare remediation offsets csv; Omar -> confirm proxy fix and publish postmortem notes; Aiden -> hold notifications and verify no more emails; Jess -> customer comms draft. I'll keep thread open for handoff.
Lina (billing): initial backfill run shows 88% of duplicates removed, remaining ones queued for manual review. I'll post CSV to secure bucket when ready.
Omar (ml-infra): we've rolled a proxy fix that ensures idempotency header gets generated upstream. Patch deployed to eu-west-1 at +10m.
Sam (oncall): handing off to day team for continued reconciliation. Handoff summary: mitigation in place (safe-mode flag, paused notifications), backfill running (job bf-...), proxy patch deployed, monitoring tightened. Followups: customer-level refunds/credits if reconciliation shows overbilling.
Aiden (sre): acknowledged handoff. I'll keep the alerts suppressed until Lina confirms reconciliation complete.
Jess (support): noted. I'll queue the post to customers once Lina provides the reconciliation window.
Lina (billing): uploading offsets CSV to s3://redwood-incident-uploads/1768509999/offsets.csv (access restricted). Will update here when reconciliation finishes (~40m).
Sam (oncall): thanks team. marking this thread live mitigation -> postmortem required. If any new spike, ping #incidents urgently. :rotating_light:
